In determining the charge for walking and bathing `4` dogs on `text(Saturday)andtext(Sunday)`, the student multiplied `8.50` times `4` `text(twice)` to account for `text(Saturday)andtext(Sunday)` (`text(cost)xx4` `text(dogs)+text(cost)xx4` `text(dogs)ortext(cost)xx4` `text(dogs)xx2` `text(days)`). To determine how much money Kassidy earned walking and bathing dogs `text(last weekend)` (the value of the expression), the student could have used the order of operations (represented by acronyms such as BODMAS and PEMDAS).
